## Ach

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/ach/overview): ACH Direct Debit is a payment method that runs on the ACH (Automated Clearing House) network in the United States.
- [Configuration](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/ach/configuration/): ACH Direct Debit is available to
- [Client-side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/ach/client-side/): ACH Direct Debit is available to [eligible merchants](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/ach#availability).
- [Server-side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/ach/server-side/): Important Your integration may be impacted by upcoming certificate changes. Visit our
- [Testing and Go Live](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/ach/testing-go-live/): When testing verification methods that require routing numbers, you can use any real 9-digit bank routing number (e.g. 011000015).
- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/ach/instant-verification/overview/): ACH Instant Verifications is a feature that allows you to instantly verify a customer's US bank account through open banking connections, before initiating an ACH payment.
